# SAP Learners

> > Comprehensive SAP learning resource covering ABAP development, S/4 HANA, SAP Fiori, OData, and enterprise transaction codes.

SAP Learners provides tutorials, technical guides, and reference documentation for SAP professionals learning ABAP, modern UI frameworks, cloud development, and database administration. The site specializes in hands-on tutorials for CDS Views, OData integration, and SAP Business Application Studio, alongside extensive transaction code and database table references.

## Key Topics

- ABAP
- S/4 HANA
- SAP Fiori
- SAPUI5
- SAP OData
- CDS Views
- SAP Business Application Studio
- Transaction Codes (TCodes)
- SAP HANA
- ABAP Development Tools
- Database Tables
- Workflow Management
- SAP BTP
- Enterprise Resource Planning
- SAP Administration

## ABAP & Development Tutorials

- [SAP ABAP](https://saplearners.com/sap-abap): SAP ABAP overview covering CDS Views, SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, and OData
- [ABAP CDS View Tutorials](https://saplearners.com/abap-cds-view-tutorials): Tutorials on ABAP CDS Views with DDL source code in ABAP Development Tools
- [SAP OData Tutorials](https://saplearners.com/sap-odata-tutorial): Comprehensive OData tutorials for SAP ABAP development and integration
- [SAP Business Application Studio Tutorials](https://saplearners.com/sap-business-application-studio-tutorials): Cloud-based SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori development environment tutorials

## S/4 HANA & Technical Guides

- [S/4 HANA Technical](https://saplearners.com/s-4-hana-technical): S/4 HANA technical guides covering ABAP, CDS Views, Fiori, and SAPUI5

## Transaction Codes Reference

- [SAP TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes): Comprehensive reference list of SAP transaction codes and navigation
- [SAP ABAP TCodes - Helpful List (2023)](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-abap-tcodes): Comprehensive list of 2000+ SAP ABAP transaction codes and tools
- [SAP ABAP Language TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-abap-language-tcodes): SAP ABAP language transaction codes reference and tools
- [SAP Business Workflow TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-bc-bmt-wfm-sap-business-workflow-tcodes): SAP Business Workflow transaction codes for workflow definition and monitoring
- [SAP Flexible Workflow TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-flexible-workflow-tcodes): SAP Flexible Workflow transaction codes for S/4HANA workflow configuration
- [SAP Workflow Error Analysis TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-workflow-error-analysis-tcodes): Workflow error analysis transaction codes for troubleshooting

## Database Tables Reference

- [SAP FI Bank Accounting Tables](https://saplearners.com/sap-fi-bank-accounting-tables): Complete reference of SAP FI Bank Accounting database tables
- [SAP FI Account Receivable Tables](https://saplearners.com/sap-fi-accounts-receivable-tables): SAP FI Accounts Receivable database tables reference for S/4HANA and ECC
- [SAP FI Asset Accounting Tables (2023)](https://saplearners.com/sap-fi-asset-accounting-tables): SAP FI Asset Accounting database tables reference for S/4HANA and ECC

## Optional Resources

- [20 SAP Archive TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/bc-ccm-adk-sap-archive-tcodes): SAP Archive transaction codes for administration and archiving
- [26 SAP Background Processing TCodes](https://saplearners.com/tcodes/sap-background-processing-tcodes): SAP Background Processing transaction codes reference
- [Glossary Archive - SAP FREE Tutorials](https://saplearners.com/sap-glossary): SAP glossary and terminology archive for learning resources
